nom: Sun Bum Original Face and Body Stick SPF 40

avis.titre: yay! it doesn't burn my eyes!
avis.texte: after a few pool days of my eyes stinging horribly,my friend recommended a stick instead of lotion (I was using la Roche previously) and this baby works great! smells good too!

avis.titre: A must have for your summer days.
avis.texte: Alright so this stuff is a must! We go to the waterpark once a week and we all use different sun screen. Last week EVERYONE burned but me. I used this face and body stick and it was amazing. The coverage was perfect. You could see where I missed because I did get a little red there. The smell is like heaven and being on vacation. It is not greasy and feels light and soft on skin. We have already purchased 2 more sticks. That's the only negative thing is that the sticks are rather small.
It feels smooth on skin and It's small so you can carry it with you always and just use when you need it. It will heal you for every occasion and the protection it give your skin it's wort it.

avis.titre: Convenient easy to use some protection in a portable easy to
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using the Sun Bum Face + Body Stick 40. The stick application is wonderful. It makes it quick, easy and mess free, especially when I'm on the go. It slides on smoothly without a greasy or heavy feel to it and provides reliable sun protection throughout the day. The scent is light and not overpowering. One of my favorite things about this project is that it did not cause any irritation or breakouts, even nonsense of areas on my face. It fits easily in my purse or beach bag, making it convenient to reapply as necessary. Overall, this is one of my favorites of the Sun Bum products. I would definitely buy it again.

This SPF stick is different from any other spf's i've used. I am used to the traditional lotions and have even tried sprays, so I was excited to review something new. This stick glides onto the skin like butter, and while it first appears yellow, it blends in seamlessly. The smell is pleasing, unlike other sunscreens with that strong spf smell. Only thing to watch out for is the oiliness left behind, which I don't mind as I only use it on my arms and I like the glow. This product is also advertised as a face SPF, but I didn't try it, as it contains fragrance and my face is sensitive. I'm not sure if they have a bigger size, but this is a great travel size or even just something to carry in your everyday bag.

Sun Bum Face + Body Stick SPF 40 works great. With the twist up tube, it was very easy to spread it on my face and especially my nose. It went on very smoothly and spread in without leaving streaks. It worked very well and I had no sunburn even though I was outside for a long time.

I love SunBum products and this Face & Body stick is a great addition to my sunscreen routine. It's easy to apply and the best part is that it is cooling when you apply it which feels great on a hot day. It is perfect to throw in my bag so I always have it on me when I need a touch up. It if effective and has the SunBum scent that I like with no mess. It is also water resistant and can be smoothly applied to wet or dry skin and it doesn't make my face shiny. A great solid sunscreen.

It's cute and dainty bottle making it easy to carry on you or with esp over the summer! I like the texture. Sun bum is easy to apply. I don't love all the chemicals but it's hard to find a clean SPF stick.

This sunscreen stick has quickly become one of my favorite beach bag and everyday essentials! ☀️💛 the application is so easy – just swipe and go. It glides on smoothly without feeling greasy, heavy or sticky, which is a huge win for me. I love that it's compact enough to toss in my purse or beach tote for quick touchups throughout the day. It's also super kid friendly making sunscreen re-application much less of a struggle when we're out and about. The SPF 40 protection hold up really well even during long days outside and I appreciate that it's water resistant. As someone with sensitive skin I'm always cautious with sunscreen products but this one does not clog my pores or cause any breakouts or irritation. For the quality and convenience I absolutely recommend this product. I love it! 🏖️

Is my first time trying in a bar sunscreen and I discovered something new that I like now! Is super easy to use and super easy to apply. One thing I love is that doesn't have that crazy or typical sunscreen smell so it's great for an everyday use. The stick feels a little bit dry so you don't really feel when your body absorbs it but is great because you're not walking around with sunscreen dripping everywhere! I think is great to have it around in the purse or backpack in this summer time.

avis.titre: It does exactly what it says!
avis.texte: I like how compact it is. It's not bulky like other sunscreens. I like how smooth it goes on. It's not greasy. It doesn't have a bad scent. It lasts long and my skin did not burn.
This spray works well on tangled hair. It makes brushing easier and leaves the hair soft . The bottle looks great on the counter. No more knots on your hair.
Excellent durability, effectiveness,and surprising coverage,very good are its ingredients, it has good valur ........................

I really enjoy this face + body stick spf. I like the packaging it comes in, it's very convenient. It doesn't leave any residue after I apply it to my face and rub it into my skin which is a plus. I'd say it lasts a decent amount of time before I have to reapply and it doesn't leave my face feeling greasy.

The Sun Bum Face + Body Stick SPF 40 is easy to apply, lightweight, and perfect for on-the-go sun protection. It glides smoothly on the skin, feels hydrating, and provides reliable SPF coverage without a greasy finish. Great for beach days, outdoor activities, and quick reapplication throughout the day!

avis.titre: Great for small touch ups on body
avis.texte: This Sun screen stick is advertised as a face and body stick, and while it can be used on both it has a shiny/white cast residue so I would only use it on my body (hence the 4 stars). It works great and I used it several times already this summer mostly to touch up spots like my scalp, shoulders, neck, etc. but would not use it on my face! I have acne prone skin though so that's why. I did receive this from Influenster to review and that's my Honest opinion! Like all products from this brand it smells great and not like sunscreen which I do love, but definitely don't want to use it on my face :)

I have used this daily for the past week while at the pool and it works beautifully. It goes on easily and doesn't feel sticky or heavy. My skin feels moisturized and like all Sun Bum products, it smells great without causing irritation to my sensitive skin.

This Sun Bum sunscreen stick is hydrating and water resistant. I love that the size of the tube is convenient to bring on the go! It applies easily and doesn't have a strong smell. I also appreciate that it is cruelty-free. I don't love the idea of spreading the same stick on my body and my face, but I appreciate that it is safe for both.

This products packaging is very convenient as it's in a roll up stick form. When putting it on it's pretty thick and creamy. It has a yellow tint to it which surprisingly did not leave a cast. This is a very heavy spf so it's definitely not for everyday use or under makeup. It also has a very strong scent of artificial banana which personally I do not like. I can only see myself using this if I'm doing something active or having a day by the beach or pool.

This is a really nice sunscreen stick!! The product itself applies so easily but it's also easy to use too much. I applied too much the first tine I used it and it did give me a greasy feeling at first but it did go away. The smell is light and not overwhelming! The best thing about this no white cast and as a black person I know what it's like to look like a ghost,lol! I wish there was a bit more product. I like to use a lighter spf on my face for added moisture and use this on top of it and especially on my neck. It so quick to apply! I recommend this!!

I absolutely love this product! The stick format makes it incredibly convenient for quick on the go reapplication throughout the day. Skin -loving ingredients that cause zero irritation. The absorption is fast and lightweight. Its washability is impressive it cleans off easily at night with a regular cleanser.

Absolutely loving the Sun Bum Face + Body Stick SPF 40! As someone always on the go, it fits perfectly on my vanity next to my keys and daily makeup (as shown in my photo. The application is quick, smooth, and non-greasy, and it has that lovely signature tropical scent. It's my new must-have for quick touch-ups before I head out.

avis.titre: portable, mess, free, easy application, light weights feel,
avis.texte: As someone who spends a lot of time outdoors, traveling, at the beach, and on cruises, I loved how convenient this Sun Bum Face and Body stick SPF 40 was to use. The stick format makes application quick and less free, especially for touchups throughout the day. It glides on smoothly without feeling heavy or greasy, and didn't leave a noticeable white cast on my skin. I also appreciated how portable it is easy to toss into a beach bag, purse, or carry-on without worrying about leaks. The application around the face was especially convenient, and I liked being able to target areas that tend to get the most sun exposure. Overall, this is a great option for anyone looking for a travel, friendly sunscreen that's easy to reapply on the go.
The sun stick worked very well and was convient to use but I barley got a month out of it. Not cost effective but again convient.

Scent of coconut automatically takes me to summertime and the beach. Love the glide on applicator so no more lotion all over your hands. This is hands free application. Smooth and non oily and can use on face and body. SPF 40 and water resistant for an hour and a half. This is my new sunscreen for summer.

I live in AZ, so sunscreen is a daily ritual!!! I absolutely appreciate the size of this, it's easy to take everywhere. I really enjoy the delicious scent and how nicely it feels on my skin. It feels smooth and breathable. Don't forget, I live in AZ, I'm never looking to make myself feel hotter!

Perfect sunscreen stick for a daily routine! Goes on smoothly and has a mild scent. Great value for what it cost and doesnt have as many harsh chemicals as other brands. I don't wear foundation but it doesnt apply to thick on the skin so I'm sure you could apply it with makeup to build on top of it.

I like the convenience of the stick format , but I wasn't a fan of how it felt on my face. It leaves a very greasy and shiny finish that feel heavy on my skin. I was hoping for something more lightweight, specifically for everyday use. It works better for the body, but for facial application it was much too oily.

avis.titre: Love This Sun Bum SPF Stick!
avis.texte: Super easy to apply, no mess, feels light on skin, and no white cast. Great daily protection with a nice light scent. I love it and use it every day!

I love this sunscreen. It doesn't leave any White cast on my face, and my skin feels really hydrated. I also love how práctica it is since I don't have to use my hands to apply it, and it has a delicious coconut scent. I love it
i loved this sunscreen ! it applied this and it absorbed on my skin like butter and it had a smell of bananas , which i loved ! i used this at volcano bay water park and it was so convenient !

I love to have this in our bag for the ball field! We get a lot of sun and not much shade so this is nice to have for quick and easy sun protection on our face. It goes on easy which is great for my 2 year old that doesn't want to be bothered by putting full sunscreen on

Honestly I'm shocked how much I like this sunscreen. Crazy that it doesn't smell like sunscreen at all. It smells like bananas? Or maybe that's just some subliminal effect from the color lol. I've been using it on my face and there's no white cast, which is lovely. It does feel a touch greasy going on, but it doesn't break me out and once it's rubbed in and given a minute it feels fine. Plus putting makeup on top feels great and it doesn't slide around. I haven't tested it in full sun like on a beach or anything but it seems to be effective. I think it's a winner!

avis.titre: Great stick for a small job
avis.texte: This stick is significantly better than other products I have previously used from competitors. It leaves no residue, absorbs quickly, and provides a subtle, glowing finish. It is excellent for refreshing SPF protection while on the go. The scent is also pleasant. I would recommend this stick for facial use, though it may not be as effective for full-body application.

I use Sun Bum often but I had never tried the stick before. The packaging is very convenient & fits perfect in any beach bag or purse. The scent just smells like summer and it goes on nicely & easy in the stick form. It has great coverage and good sun protection when applied as recommended. It does not feel too oily or thick. The only negative thing I have to say about this product is it is very little product for the price and I would definitely use it more on my face than my body because it could run out fast.

I'm a regular Sun Bum SPF user, and this stick is a convenient, quick application product! Glides on easy and has the classic Sun Bum scent. I will say I prefer their kids' clear sun stick for the face more, but this product is great for body reapplication when out and about!

This product is amazing! It has such a nice cooling effect to it and is the perfect size for your beach bag! The product does not leave any residue and sits very well on the skin! The smell is wonderful as well! Definitely would recommend

avis.titre: Easy to apply, no sticky residue
avis.texte: So, this is my very first time using a solid SPF stick! I really like it so far! The solid sunscreen applies super easy and isn't sticky at all. In my picture, i have a thick application on my wrist. It's ever so slightly visible but the residue doesn't show if you use a normal amount. Even the thick coat residue went away pretty quick! It felt really nice on the skin and not too heavy. I use different products on my face and body so i think i'd use to separate sticks. Of course, you might be different! I'd definitely buy this, if nothing else for the ease of use. Plus it's easy to apply when you're out. I forgot to mention the best part: no mess on your palms! Don't forget to apply it to your hands too though!
I love the convenience of the stick on the go! The formula does not make me break out. Its convenient for all skin types.

avis.titre: Sun Bum for the Summer Sun
avis.texte: The Sun Bum Face Stick has that classic banana sunscreen scent that instantly gives Summer vibes without being overpowering. The smaller applicator makes it super easy to apply directly to the face, especially on my grandchildren, and I loved not having to worry about it getting into their eyes. It went on smoothly with no greasy residue and held up surprisingly well in the Texas heat, even with daily sweating and pool time. Reapplying after about 90 minutes felt pretty standard, and while I do wish the stick itself was bigger, the compact size is perfect for tossing into a purse or beach bag for on-the-go sun protection.
Love how easy this sunblock is. Our whole family uses it! We use it for both our face and body. We don't get piling and it lasts quite a while. Easy to reapply as well.

Works pretty well! Goes on smooth, without a white cast on my darker skin tone. Does not irritate or break out my skin. Provides solid sun protection and I like that the applicator is a stick making it easy to control how much you use.
I will be returning this product because the ingredients are not safe.

Beach day essentials! I've been loving the easy, mess free application of sun bum face and body stick SPF 40. Perfect for a quick reapplication while out in the sun and leaves my skin feeling protected without the greasy feel.

I LOVE this Sun Bum product! I especially love the packaging and the stick so it's easy to apply to your face, neck, and ears. The texture is nice and it's not too greasy. The smell is great, it reminds me of tropical paradise. The SPF 40 is ideal for me as a fair skinned person who sunburns easily. This will be a staple for me all summer long. Highly recommend this product for everyone.

This Sun Bum stick is amazing! I love that it's for face and body. It glides on so smoothly and evenly making great for easy application. It feels smooth on skin and goes on perfectly. Being a stick format makes it perfect for quick application or great for on the go! I recommend to everyone!

avis.titre: Perfect on the go sun protection
avis.texte: I've been loving this Sun Bum face and body stick spf. It is perfect for on the go sun protection. The stick format makes it super easy and mess free to apply, specially on my face and shoulders. It glides smoothly without feeling greasy or heavy which makes it absorb nicely. Perfect size to keep on my travel bag for beach days and quick reapplications throughout the day. I like that it did not irritate my skin nor made it feel dry.

avis.titre: The best sunscreen I've ever used!
avis.texte: If you haven't tried this sunscreen do it! The thing I love most is that you can use it on your face without it burning and feeling sticky like some sunscreen's! Walk don't run.

Love the smell of this product and how it feels on the skin! Cute packaging makes it even more desirable to wear. The value is unbeatable and it doesn't leave any residue like other spf products. Especially works for the clean girl flowery aesthetic for summer without looking greasy.

Thank you Influenster for providing this Sun Bum Face + Body stick 40, for free of charge, in order for my honest review. This stick is easy to use and apply. It worked great, without feeling greasy or heavy. The scent is light and pleasant smells. The SPF 40 is great for everyday use. Overall I love this sunscreen stick and highly recommended.

avis.titre: A convenient non greasy sun stick that offers grea
avis.texte: I am really impressed with the Sun Bum Face + Body Stick. The effective is great for long days outside and I love how quickly the absorption happens without leaving a greasy residue the consistency is smooth making it easy to apply on the go. In terms of wearability it feels lightweight on my skin and provides lasting comfort throughout the day it definitely become a staple in my beach bag.

I love the fragrance, it's less greasy and very easy to apply.ess free application also good for those touch ups. Portable and was to carry in your pocket too. Best part is it is without oxygen zone. Overall a good product.
I love this product. Its very easy to apply and store in my bag. It last for about 2hrs before i have to reapply. This product goes on smooth on my skin and feels very moisturizing.

This is the perfect on the go sunscreen! I had it in my purse all day in the heat and it didn't melt or spill at all! It smells amazing and feels so lightweight on my skin! it left an amazing glowy and smooth finish!

I'm obsessed with this sun protection stick. The texture is smooth and doesn't leave behind white streaks or a greasy residue. It's incredibly practical for touch-ups during the day. On top of that, the packaging is compact and the scent is a delicious summer vibe."

I love this Sun Bum Sunscreen Stick for so many reasons! One is that it doesn't smell like sunscreen. It smells like bananas, which is amazing!! I love that it's travel-size and a lot easier to carry than a traditional bottle of sunscreen. I love that it doesn't give a sticky, slimy residue, and my makeup doesn't seem to slide off (I usually do give it some time to set on my face before putting makeup on, though. I also like that I can use it on my body too! I can also use it on my toddler.

avis.titre: Perfect little SPF stick for pool & boating days ☀
avis.texte: I tried the Sun Bum SPF 40 Face & Body Stick and really liked it! It has a very pleasant light scent and feels like it protects the skin really well during sunny days. I love the compact stick design - it's super convenient and easy to apply in the face, neck, shoulders and other small areas without making a mess. I've been using it at the pool and on boating days, and it's so easy to keep in my bag and reapply anytime. The packaging is cute and practical too. Great option for sun protection on the go.
This face & body stick is very convenient and has a pleasant scent. I really like it because it's very easy to apply AND it doesn't leave ANY white residue.

This is a great sunscreen stick. It goes on smooth and is not greasy at all. It works well with makeup and doesnt make my makeup clump up. It lasts a long time too. I will definitely be purchasing this when I run out. I looked it up and it's very reasonably priced.

avis.titre: Easy to use and does the job
avis.texte: I burn easily and this product saved my skin when I had to spend the day outside with students at field day. I reapplied once and only turned a little pink after five hours in the sun. It's so easy to roll on, and it has such a soft fresh scent. It is easy to toss in my bad and go without worrying about spills or messes.
Package arrived damaged but the product was in tact. Decent product. Feels a bit waxy like other sunscreen sticks. Decent performance. Good value. No breakouts.

avis.titre: Excellent sunblock in a convenient twist-up
avis.texte: Love this Sun Bum balm! It fits perfectly in a small purse, and it's for face and body, so it's all you need! It easily twists out to apply. Smell is minimal, so nothing overpowering if you use it on your face. Absorbs quickly. Don't leave it in a hot car as it will melt.

Tried this on a trail run for track practice. I love how easy it is to take with you. No mess stick. Glided on the skin. Didnt feel heavy on the face. The cooling feeling felt nice when reapplying. Love it. Plan to buy more!

Love this Sun Bum Face + Body Stick SPF40. So easy to apply. Smells amazing. Worked great. Spent a few days at the beach and used it daily and never got burned on my face and my face felt soft and not dry. It wasn't greasy and was smooth when applying.

avis.titre: First time stick user, will definitely not be the
avis.texte: I recently put the Sun Bum Face + Body Stick SPF 40 to the test during a full hour of mowing the grass on one of the sunniest days we've had this season. I was skeptical about a stick formula holding up under that kind of sustained outdoor activity, but I was genuinely impressed. It glided on smoothly without feeling greasy or heavy, and it stayed put even as I worked up a sweat. My skin felt protected the entire time and I came back inside without so much as a hint of a burn. The scent is light and pleasant, very on-brand for Sun Bum, and I loved how easy it was to reapply even when sweaty. For anyone who needs a reliable, fuss-free sunscreen for yard work or any other outdoor activity, this stick delivers.

avis.titre: Great coverage with more even application than lot
avis.texte: I absolutely love using this sunscreen! It is incredibly convenient; I no longer have to use my hands to spread the cream and then wash them clean afterward. I also really appreciate that this product is safe for both my son and me to use, meaning we don't have to carry multiple different sunscreens in our bag whenever we go out. The product works extremely effectively, protecting our skin from sunburn while we were on the catamaran as well as when relaxing on the beach after diving. The cream has a very light and pleasant scent. When first applied, it appears white, but with just a gentle rub, it blends completely into the skin and becomes invisible.

avis.titre: Great Travel Size, Easy to Put On, Nice Fragrance
avis.texte: First, I love how easy it is to carry around mess free unlike large bottles. Application is really easy, though it feels just a bit greasy after you put it on. I enjoy the light banana fragrance that comes off of it, it isn't too strong. As for how well it works, I can't say much since it's been very rainy and gloomy in my area.

The Sun Bum Face and Body Stick SPF 40 is super convenient and easy to use, especially for quick sunscreen reapplication throughout the day. I like how compact it is because it fits easily in a bag, pocket, or car without taking up much space. The stick glides on smoothly and makes applying sunscreen to the face a lot less messy than traditional lotions. It also feels lightweight on the skin and doesn't leave behind a heavy or greasy feeling. The SPF 40 protection is great for everyday outdoor activities, and the stick format makes it easy to apply to smaller areas like the nose, cheeks, ears, and shoulders. Overall, it's a simple, practical sunscreen option that's easy to keep with you anywhere. Highly recommend!
Such a great SpF I'm obsessed it's super lightweight cute and small to carry on . Such a cooling experience on my skin and the presentation itself it's amazing !

Way better way to apply sunscreen in my option then the typical spray and lotion. The overall scent was pleasant and didn't have that sticky effect on my skin. Overall great product that I'd use over and over again

Sun Bun did a great job protecting my face from the sun rays! It glides on easy with application directly to the face and smells amazing. The scent is that of cocoa butter and/or shea butter. It lasted for the entire 1.5 hours I spent in the pool in direct sun. There was no residue left behind when I washed my face! I will recommend 10/10!

avis.titre: Mess-free Florida sun skin protector with a most d
avis.texte: When you want to enjoy a long day in the sun and feel like a bum, this is it. When my family and I go to the beach or sit around the pool all day, I can trust that sun bum will keep me from feeling a burning regret after being in the Florida sun all day. The best part? That smell. I wish Sun Bum sold this scent in deodorants and other hygienic products. The product is small, but a little goes a longgggg way. Maybe there is more product in the sprays, but half the time all that spray goes off into the wind. It also does not make your skin feel greasy and gross which is a huge plus as my wife has sensitive skin.

avis.titre: A great item from trusted loved brand
avis.texte: I love sun bum products. I've been purchasing for several years. The smell is fabulous. I think I like the short chunky stick. Easy to hold and keep up with. No burn in eyes smells great glides on easily.

Love this sunscreen! It's super easy to use since its in the stick form. Absorbs super easily and lasts! Reapplying is a breeze and it's perfect size to store in a bag and not take up room. It's at a great price point and I plan on buying this going forward!

This was my first time trying a sunscreen in stick form, and it did not disappoint! The packaging is very convenience and avoids getting your hands dirty for application. The sunscreen glides on like butter and feels moisturizing. It made my face slightly oily, but I do already have oily skin. Compared to other products it did not make my skin overly oily. It definitely provided good sun protection. The sunscreen also smelled like a coconut and banana mix, perfect for summer days! It's my newest addition to my must haves on the go bag I carry on the daily. I would highly recommend for the convenience.

This sunscreen stick smells like coconuts and summer. I love that you can easily slide it across your face and body for full coverage without getting your hands covered in sunscreen. It's got a creamy texture and goes on clear without leaving any irritation or residue.

avis.titre: Easy sunblock stick, ready to go!
avis.texte: Ready for the Summer with this great little convenient face and body stick. Easy to just pop in any beach or pool bag and spread on with out getting it all over your hands. It's so easy to apply and rubs in clear with no visible residue. It lasts 80mins without having to reapply, even in the water! It has no added fragrance to worry about. Just simple and ready to go.

Long time Sun Bum fan. This lil guy is perfect. I have started a new medication that makes my poor face sensitive to sunlight and this pocket sized powerhouse is the perfect addition to my routine. It's got that classic sun bum smell that's just Devine. It slides on easy doesn't feel gritty and rubs in effortlessly. It fit in any bag and it perfect for me since I'm constantly forgetting this step in my routine.

Does it job well: it protects, hydrates, and is super convenient to carry. The best part is how easy it is to apply ; the downside is it can feel a bit heavy in the heat. Great for the face and quick touch-ups, not ideal for full body use.

I absolutely loved this product! its very gentle on my son's skin as well, I really love how it has an almost soft texture. I will definitely be buying those, i received this product free in return for a review. I would definitely recommend it does not leave an oily finish like most.

avis.titre: This stick is a lifesaver for quick protection.
avis.texte: This stick is a lifesaver for quick protection. It has a pleasant send, and glides on smoothly without any peeling or leaving a greasy residue unlike other sticks, it feels hydrating rather than drying on the skin perfect for effortless mess free touchups.
I received it and I really liked it , I'll talk about it after I use it 😍. But I probably like it because it's compact and provides sun protection for both face and body 👍🏼

avis.titre: Smooth, lightweight and perfect for on the go sun
avis.texte: I love sunscreen stick. The texture is smooth and glides easily on the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. It absorbs well and leaves the skin hydrated and comfortable. It also provides great sun protection and is perfect for reapplying throughout the day. The scent is light and pleasant, not overpowering. I highly recommend it, especially to carry in your bag and use quickly without any mess.

avis.titre: Excellent product to take care of our face
avis.texte: Excellent product for daily use to take care of the sun, the texture is very soft so that you do not feel your face so heavy when using it. Loving that product

Omg it's perfect for everybody. I'm going to the beach and the package was perfectly made for me. The texture is like a bb cream. Fast absorption no irritation, the sun protection is 40 spf sooo this is amazing. I love it
This classic scent is easy to apply and comes in a great size for my mini bag. My skin feels soft and not sticky after using it. Highly recommended for daily use.

avis.titre: Easy, Mess Free Sun Protection on the Go
avis.texte: I really like the Sun Bum face and body stick with SPF 40. It's a quick, no-fuss sunscreen stick. The stick is super convenient, with no spills or greasy hands. It glides on smoothly and feels lightweight on the skin. The scent is subtle and pleasant. It also stays on great through sweat and swimming. Don't apply too much, or you will end up having to rub it in. It hasn't caused any issues with skin irritation or breakouts. Overall, it's a reliable and travel friendly sunscreen.
I actually enjoy using this. The smell doesn't bother me like other brands do. I would buy more of these and any other kind than brand has. It removes easily

The sun bum is an effective broad spectrum sunscreen that provides solid SPF 40 protection against UVA and UVB rays, especially when applied generously and evenly, though its stick format works best for targeted areas rather than full body coverage. It suitable for beach or outdoors use, but still requires regular reapplication. In terms of of compatibility, it works well for normal skin types but may feel greasy on oily skin and could irritate sensitive skin due to its noticeable coconut like fragrance and chemical filters. It's a convenient portable option ideal for quick reapplication on the go
Good sunscreen stick, doesnt have that weird sunscreen smell. Long lasting and helps hydrate the skin. Good for playing outside or even just working outdoors. Very useful.

I love this stuff! Super easy to use. The smell reminds me of when I would spend my days at the beach. It is a slight scent of tropical and is not overwhelming. It is that wonderful smell on your skin that reminds you of being at the beach and all you have after being home is that leftover smell on your skin. It seems as if it goes on thick, but it rubs right in. Almost like a Chapstick, but not greasy. It dries almost immediately. It does not leave a glossy or shiny finish on your skin. One of the best part is how easy it is to apply. It it's perfect for parents with impatient little ones who need a quick touchup as well as husbands who don't like sunscreen. My favorite part is the applicator.. I pull the cap off and I can dab my upper lip and under my eyes. Sun destroys collagen and the two areas I always try to reapply consistently as my upper lip and under my eyes. This stick makes it so easy and it dabs right over my make-up too. It is SPF 40. Which is perfect for sunny-sunny days.

avis.titre: Easy, Mess-Free Sun Protection On the Go ☀️
avis.texte: I've been using the Sun Bum Face + Body Stick SPF 40 for a few weeks now, and it has quickly become one of the easiest sunscreens I've tried to apply. The stick format is extremely practical: no spills, no greasy hands, and it's perfect to carry in your bag for quick reapplications. The application is smooth, gliding on without tugging the skin, and it leaves only a slight white cast at first, which blends out quite well. The texture is lightweight, non-sticky, and best of all, it doesn't clog my pores or cause breakouts—something essential for my sensitive skin. In short, this sunscreen combines convenience, lightness, and reliable protection, making it ideal for daily use without any hassle.￼
